mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_notification_log ( application_id, document_srl, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason ) VALUES ( #{applicationId}, #{documentSrl}, #{channelType}, #{targetAddressMasked}, #{keywordSummary}, #{sendStatus}, #{failReason} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, application_id, document_srl, channel_type, target_address_masked, keyword_summary, send_status, fail_reason, created_at FROM admin_notification_log WHERE document_srl = #{documentSrl} ORDER BY created_at DESC, id DESC
